title: CombinedCycleBlock
description: Attribute to represent combined cycle generation by block configuration that shares heat recovery conversions. CT and CA unit assignments to HRSGs are recorded as SupplementalAttributeAssociation rows, with group_index the HRSG index and role CT or CA.
